stem.text: Which statement about electric charges in a uniform electric field is **not** correct?

A.text: Electric charges of the same magnitude, whether positive or negative, experience the same magnitude of force when placed in the same uniform electric field.

B.text: The direction of the force on a positive charge placed in a uniform electric field is independent of the magnitude of the charge.

C.text: The magnitude of the force on a positive charge placed in a uniform electric field is proportional to the magnitude of the electric field strength.

D.text: The work done to move a positive charge a certain distance in a uniform electric field is independent of the direction of the movement.
